name: Chou Tzu-chih
bio: Chou Tzu-chih (周紫芝; Zhou Zizhi; 1082–1155) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The 2 ci here are from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 鹧鸪天 (Zhe gu tian)
poems.author: Chou Tzu-chih
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
一点残红欲尽时。
乍凉秋气满屏帏。
梧桐叶上三更雨，叶叶声声是别离。
调宝瑟，拨金猊。
那时同唱鹧鸪词。
如今风雨西楼夜，不听清歌也泪垂。

poems.title: 踏莎行 (Ta sha xing)
poems.author: Chou Tzu-chih
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
情似游丝，人如飞絮。
泪珠阁定空相觑。
一溪烟柳万丝垂，无因系得兰舟住。
雁过斜阳，草迷烟渚。
如今已是愁无数。
明朝且做莫思量，如何过得今宵去。
